HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: shit hole
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The place is officially a shit hole. We Goblins have known far worse.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The place has sunk back to being a shit hole. We Goblins don't care much. What expectations do we have?

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: mucky pit
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: Enough goblins squelch about that the place now counts as a mucky pit.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: Too few goblins remain, and it's a horrible mucky pit once again.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: shed
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The living situation has upgraded into a shed. A shed! There are far better palaces to celebrate, but a shed has not been known before. A feast, of Elven meat! of Men meat!
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The goblins have shrunk back to shed numbers. A previously joyous goblin community have begun making their aggrindised feelings on the matter very public.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: hovel
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The Goblin hovel. Never before would one find a more wretched hive of scum and villainy. Men and Elven visitors who get too close are advised - by Goblin negotiators - to prepare for "peace" talks.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The old place has somehow slipped back down to a hovel. Fuck sake.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: burrow
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: Tunnels, nooks and goblins everywhere. The burrow is thriving, bones are broken, and meat is back on the menu, boys!
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The tunnels stand empty. The hole is a burrow once more. What a load of OLD SHIT.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: den
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The new den grows loud and crowded. Neighbours grow nervous, but we still invite them to visit for... trade, and... entertainment!
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The place is quieter than it was, and has receded to a den. The Hobs are not without their excuses, and, perhaps - profound, blind rage.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: town
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The goblins drown each other's stupidity out, such that some even sound legible. The place now - somehow - constitutes a town, and it even appears on elven maps.
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The place has thinned out. It's a town again, but only just. Everyone is confused and angry; perhaps such is the cause and not the condition?

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: fort
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: What was once known as a hole is somehow now called a fort, with terrible goblin traditions. There are so many bodies now that an innocent murder here, a genuine accident there - all jotted down to "workplace efficiency".
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The hole has marginally thinned out. It's down to a fort again - a slightly quieter, somehow more dangerous place where goblin-kin brood and yearn over past glory.

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: goblin stronghold
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The Gob-stronghold has formed. None can question the progress of this perfect Goblin society whom now drive a stronghold capable of conquering arsehole Elves and Men alike. History is being rewritten, and the age of Men is done. The time of Or--I mean, Goblin, has come!
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: We are back to being a stronghold. We must not be defeated. We will know our might soon again, as Goblins! Death to Elves! Death to Men! And death to Elves, once again!

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: goblin citadel
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: Hundreds of Goblins have arisen from the muck, and will conquer this blighted Elven world. The Citadel of Goblins thrives and thrusts ever-forward. Thrust forward gobbie bastards!
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: The goblin Citadel has somewhat reduced. It remains a large gathering of experienced Goblin officers and soldiers, but it remains to be seen whether we will re-organise, or perish forever. To arms, Gobby-bastards!

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: goblin city
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: Behold! A true Goblin City. A simple Citadel could no longer possibly contain our majesty, might, or need for Man-meat. We rise faster than ever. We are primed to take over this Elven shit hole. Rise, gobs, and prepare to dominate those fuckers!
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.demotedText: Our goblin city has been somewhat decimated in our lust for conquest. The Snoblins insist we retreat, but everyone knows they're full of shit. We must attack! Attack again, the disgusting Elves and Men must be wiped from the face of the planet, while they suspect our retreat!

HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.label: goblin kingdom
HobGob.Census.GoblinCensusTierDef.promotedText: The Goblin Kingdom is established. The war is won. The King is dominant. We will rend the Men, and the Elves' leaders' meat from their bones, and prepare a grand feast. Eat the bastards!
